title: The transform generation this contract's evidence belongs to
why: A fixture or a store record is evidence about the transform that produced it, and only about that one. The frozen collection was once found to hold 67 materials whose tangent numbers predated a correction and were evidence of nothing -- they looked exactly like current ones. So the current fingerprint is recorded in ONE place that both repositories read, rather than as a constant hard-coded on each side where the two can drift silently.
evidence_status: This fingerprint identifies current code as of 2026-10-07 (corpus robustness campaign, batch B17: the callee lookup, the NTENS at which a source is transformed, the interface found by argument position, free-form includes and timing calls, the OTI order-2 divisor, the utility stubs of the offline drivers and the D-12 init probe move the fingerprint). The current corpus evidence is pass24 (2026-10-07/08, harness 0b2c472c7085b594, contract 5.0.0): all 419 acquired sources (the 405 of pass23 and the 14 of the 2026-10-06 host round) re-transformed (298 transform, 278 compile) and every stored entry re-verified in Abaqus 2021 -- 106 verified in Abaqus under the D-4 tangent gate of 242 as published (106 of 246 with the revised callee rule, 242 minus 0 plus 4; the 14 new sources are reported apart, none verified) and 114 at the routine level -- and the 118 cases frozen at pass24 fingerprints. Every one of the 106 and 114 sources kept its pass23 verdict; the 250 primal and DDSDDE routine cells and 875 of 903 full-run cells common to both passes are bit-identical, the 28 others differ only in a message path. The two Residual Assembler fixtures in tests/fixtures/verified were regenerated at this fingerprint (every number identical to 830e5ee95ce99cd2). Corpus pass23 (830e5ee95ce99cd2 / ec609ab41bb45a02; 106 of 242 and 114 of 242) and every earlier pass are history. The verified collection under umat/ (pass12, 94a92c01814f107a), the ten fixtures under Residual Assembler tests/fixtures/historical and every earlier generation stay retired from current capability claims and regression baselines: preserve their original generation and numerical observations and read them only as history. The re-freeze procedure is documented in docs/evidence/final_refreeze.md in both repositories.
covers: every file under src/umat_oti whose suffix is .py, .f90, .f, .for or .inc, except the subpackages listed in umat_oti.store.transform_store.NOT_TRANSFORM_CODE, which cannot change a stored transform
how_to_update: Run umat_oti.store.transform_fingerprint(), put the result here, regenerate contract_lock.json, and copy both into Residual_Assembler/schemas/. Everything frozen at the previous value is now evidence about a transform that no longer exists: re-freeze it or read it only as history. This is NOT a contract version bump -- the shape of the agreement is unchanged; what changed is which evidence is current.
consumers_must: refuse a fixture whose transform_fingerprint differs from this value as a regression baseline, and treat a fixture carrying no fingerprint as NOT ESTABLISHED rather than as current
